import os, tempfile, tomllib, flask
print("flask from:", flask.__file__)

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p = os.path.join(d, "config.toml")
with open(p, "w") as f:
    f.write('TEST_KEY="foo"\nSECRET_KEY="config"\n')

app = flask.Flask(__name__)
app.config.root_path = d
app.config.from_file("config.toml", tomllib.load, text=False)
assert app.secret_key == "config", app.secret_key
assert app.config["TEST_KEY"] == "foo"
print("tomllib text=False OK")

# default text mode still works for json
import json
jp = os.path.join(d, "config.json")
with open(jp, "w") as f:
    json.dump({"TEST_KEY": "bar", "SECRET_KEY": "s"}, f)
app2 = flask.Flask(__name__)
app2.config.root_path = d
app2.config.from_file("config.json", json.load)
assert app2.config["TEST_KEY"] == "bar"
print("json default text=True OK")
